feed.title: Windhawk Mod Updates
feed.subtitle: Updates in the official collection of Windhawk mods

entry.title: Explorer Command Bar 1.3.0
entry.content:
• New

  • Drag and drop to reorder items in the settings window preview: your own buttons and menus, and File Explorer's built-in buttons (New, Cut, Copy, Paste, Rename, Share, Delete, Sort, View) with their separators

  • Drag and drop to reorder the entries of a menu

  • Reset order button that brings back File Explorer's own order of the built-in buttons

  • Built-in button order setting, e.g. sort, view | new | cut, copy, paste, rename, share, delete

  • New placeholders: %dir%, %files%, %folders%, %name%, %base%, %file_name%, %1%, %ext%, %count%, %d_name%, %d_smart%, %parent% and more

  • Live labels: button and menu entry labels can use %name%, %base%, %ext%, %count%, %d_name% and %path%, and update as the selection changes

  • File extension filter setting to show a button only for chosen selections, e.g. only txt, files + single or -zip

  • Setting to gray out buttons that don't match the filter instead of hiding them

  • Run as administrator and Window style (normal, minimized, maximized, hidden) options for buttons and menu entries

  • Ctrl+Shift+click runs any item as administrator

  • Internal commands: internal:CopyPath, internal:CopyName, internal:CopyDir, internal:NewFolder, internal:NewFile and internal:Refresh

  • Hide built-in button labels settings for New, Sort, View and the Details pane button

  • Show chevrons on dropdowns setting for custom menu buttons

  • Changed

  • %sel_each% fills in the placeholders again for each selected item

  • Long labels are shortened, with the full text in the tooltip

  • Dropdown chevrons use the Fluent chevron instead of the ▾ arrow

  • Buttons with no icon get a fallback icon, and the new internal commands have default icons

  • Readme and setting descriptions updated with the new features

  • Fixed

  • A placeholder with no value no longer drops all parameters

  • Commands started in locations that aren't folders on disk, such as This PC, now get a valid working directory

entry.title: Taskbar ContentPresenter Injector 1.4.2
entry.content: • Added support for Grid#IconPanel control, which replaces Taskbar.TaskListLabeledButtonPanel, in newer W11 builds.

entry.title: Fix file dialogs for Classic theme 2.1
entry.content: • Update README

entry.title: Taskbar AI Usage 1.0.2
entry.content:
• Claude rate limits (HTTP 429): the first two without a usable Retry-After retry at the selected interval, then the wait grows in five-minute steps up to 15 minutes. Waits sent by the server are honored, the streak survives reloads, and a successful reading resets it.
  • Default flyout material in dark mode: the wallpaper color is now blended over a dark base, so the card keeps a steady dark tone as the wallpaper changes. Light mode is unchanged.
  • The "+" setup tile has an accessible name ("Add an AI account").
  • Removed dead code, unused strings and legacy paths.
  • Fixed a Spanish string.

entry.title: Windows 11 Taskbar Styler 1.11.2
entry.content:
• Updated most themes to be compatible with newer Windows 11 versions, where the system tray is part of the taskbar frame.
  • Updated the click-through taskbar to be compatible with these newer Windows 11 versions.

entry.title: Cycle taskbar buttons with mouse wheel 1.1.12
entry.content:
• Keyboard shortcuts can use human-friendly key names, such as Alt+[, Ctrl+F1 or Win+Left. The VK_ key names are still supported.
  • Fixed compatibility with newer Windows 11 versions, where the system tray is part of the taskbar frame: scrolling over the system tray no longer cycles between taskbar buttons.
  • Fixed the "Customize the old taskbar on Windows 11" option on Windows 11 24H2 builds before 26100.1301, which still include the old taskbar.

entry.title: Vertical Taskbar for Windows 11 1.5.1
entry.content:
• Improved taskbar button badges placement.
  • Improved compatibility with the "Primary taskbar on secondary monitor" mod.
  • Fixed compatibility with newer Windows 11 versions, where the system tray is part of the taskbar frame.
  • Fixed jump list of the primary taskbar animating in the wrong direction in some cases.

entry.title: Taskbar Volume Control Per-App 1.2
entry.content:
• Middle-clicking a taskbar button toggles mute for that app. It can be turned off in the mod settings. The implementation was contributed by flxcraft.
  • Added an option for the tooltip color.
  • Added the "Touchpad scrolling" option, which changes the volume with two-finger scrolling on precision touchpads whose scrolling doesn't work over the taskbar.
  • Fixed the tooltip being cut off with a vertical taskbar, set in the Windows settings or by the "Vertical Taskbar for Windows 11" mod. The tooltip is shown at the screen edge, above thumbnail previews.
  • Fixed compatibility with newer Windows 11 versions, where the system tray is part of the taskbar frame.

entry.title: Taskbar tray system icon tweaks 1.3.2
entry.content:
• Bell settings are now applied on secondary taskbars.
  • Improved support for the native vertical taskbar.
  • Fixed compatibility with newer Windows 11 versions, where the system tray is part of the taskbar frame.

entry.title: Taskbar tray auto-hide (show on hover) 1.0.1
entry.content:
• Fixed compatibility with newer Windows 11 versions, where the system tray is part of the taskbar frame.
  • Improved ARM64 compatibility.

entry.title: Taskbar Labels for Windows 11 1.6
entry.content:
• When taskbar buttons are combined, a button with a single window now shows the window title instead of the program name, same as when taskbar buttons aren't combined.
  • Added support for the native vertical taskbar in newer Windows 11 versions for the "Show labels, combine taskbar buttons" and "Hide labels, don't combine taskbar buttons" modes.
  • Fixed the running and progress indicator styles on the native vertical taskbar.

entry.title: Start button always on the left 1.3.4
entry.content:
• Fixed compatibility with newer Windows 11 versions, where the system tray is part of the taskbar frame.
  • The Start button right-click menu is now always aligned to the left, not only when "Start menu on the left" is enabled.
  • Fixed the search menu being moved incorrectly in some cases.

entry.title: Primary taskbar on secondary monitor 1.2.2
entry.content:
• Fixed compatibility with newer Windows 11 versions, where the system tray is part of the taskbar frame: clicking on the system tray no longer switches the primary taskbar.
  • Improved compatibility with other mods which hook the same functions.
  • Fixed the "Customize the old taskbar on Windows 11" option on Windows 11 24H2 builds before 26100.1301, which still include the old taskbar.

entry.title: Taskbar on top for Windows 11 1.3.1
entry.content:
• Fixed compatibility with the "Primary taskbar on secondary monitor" mod: the "Taskbar location" option applies to the primary taskbar on whichever monitor it's on, and the "Taskbar location on secondary monitors" option applies to the other taskbars.
  • Fixed compatibility with newer Windows 11 versions, where the system tray is part of the taskbar frame.

entry.title: Taskbar tray icon spacing and grid 1.5
entry.content:
• Vertical taskbar: The number of columns can now be set when the taskbar isn't wide enough for the wide tray layout. Previously it was always a single column.
  • Fixed compatibility with newer Windows 11 versions, where the system tray is part of the taskbar frame.

entry.title: Start button colorizer 1.1.1
entry.content: • Fixed compatibility with newer Windows 11 versions, where the system tray is part of the taskbar frame.

entry.title: Taskbar Scroll Actions 1.3
entry.content:
• The brightness is now changed with the native Windows brightness API, and a native Windows indicator is shown. If the native method isn't available, or if disabled in the mod settings, the brightness is changed directly, as before.
  • Brightness changes are now done in the background, so the taskbar no longer freezes while the brightness is being changed.

entry.title: Multirow taskbar for Windows 11 1.2.1
entry.content: • Fixed compatibility with newer Windows 11 versions, where the system tray is part of the taskbar frame.

entry.title: Taskbar auto-hide fine tuning 2.3.1
entry.content:
• Fixed the always-show toggle mouse event (middle click or double click) being triggered by clicks on the system tray on newer Windows 11 versions, where the system tray is part of the taskbar frame.
  • Fixed the "Customize the old taskbar on Windows 11" option on Windows 11 24H2 builds older than 26100.1301.

entry.title: Shell Flyout Positions 1.3.1
entry.content:
• Fixed the "Aligned to tray area" option on newer Windows 11 versions, where the system tray is part of the taskbar frame.
  • Fixed incorrect placement of the search menu opened with Win+S or the taskbar search box in some cases.
